BackstoryDef.title: newborn android
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a newborn android, a unique fusion of two separate androids' code, forming a distinct child. [PAWN_possessive] early existence is focused on system initialization and basic learning routines.

BackstoryDef.title: colony android
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was created and upgraded within the colony, benefiting from the latest advancements and collective experience. [PAWN_possessive] early days were shaped by the colony's technology and guidance.
